shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_HARD
The Kestrel
shipBlueprint.unlock: Does not require unlocking (it is the only ship, the cruiser and the layout, available from the very start of the game)
shipBlueprint.desc: This class of ship was decommissioned from Federation service years ago. After a number of refits and updating, this classic ship is ready for battle.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_HARD_2
Red-Tail
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn at least two out of three achievements for the Kestrel Cruiser
shipBlueprint.desc: This modified Kestrel class ship was created by a laser weapon aficionado.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_HARD_3
The Swallow
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reach the final sector with the Kestrel Cruiser layout B and Advanced Edition Content enabled
shipBlueprint.desc: This model was modified by pirates to utilize newly discovered technology. It can clone lost crewmembers and stun enemies.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_CIRCLE
The Torus
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reaching a sector 5 with any Kestrel Cruiser layout automatically unlocks the Engi Cruiser
shipBlueprint.desc: Although it may look like a pile of junk loosely held together, this well designed ship relies on drones and ion weaponry.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_CIRCLE_2
The Vortex
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn at least two out of three achievements for the Engi Cruiser
shipBlueprint.desc: Heavily understaffed, this ship relies on drones to keep the ship running.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_CIRCLE_3
Tetragon
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reach the final sector with the Engi Cruiser layout B and Advanced Edition Content enabled
shipBlueprint.desc: The Engi were quick to adapt to the sudden surge of hacking technology — this ship is the result of their research.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_FED
The Osprey
shipBlueprint.unlock: Defeat the Flagship prototype in the Rebel Stronghold sector to unlock this ship. Alternatively, defeat the Rebel Flagship with the Engi Cruiser.
shipBlueprint.desc: This ship features the latest in federation technology: an advanced beam weapon that pierces through shields!

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_FED_2
Nisos
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earning two of the three Federation Cruiser achievements will unlock layout B.
shipBlueprint.desc: This ship features additional Artillery power, encouraging heavy reliance on the beam.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_FED_3
The Fregatidae
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reaching Sector 8 with The Federation Cruiser B and Advanced Edition content enabled will unlock Layout C.
shipBlueprint.desc: With a Flak Artillery weapon and an improved Clone Bay, only the most suicidal of infantry chooses to fly on this ship.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_ENERGY
The Adjudicator
shipBlueprint.unlock: See the Unarmed Zoltan Transport. Alternatively, defeat The Rebel Flagship with the Federation Cruiser.
shipBlueprint.desc: The Zoltan's advanced shields technology give this ship an edge during each battle.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_ENERGY_2
Noether
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earning two of the three Zoltan Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
shipBlueprint.desc: This ship starts with a weakened Shield system and must rely on its Zoltan shield.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_ENERGY_3
Cerenkov
shipBlueprint.unlock: Getting to Sector 8 with the The Zoltan Cruiser Type B with Advanced Edition Content enabled will unlock Layout C.
shipBlueprint.desc: The designer of this ship was not willing to spend the money for a decent reactor. Instead it relies on its Zoltan crew and Backup Battery.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_JELLY
Man of War
shipBlueprint.unlock: See the Slug Home Nebula Surrender random event. Alternatively, defeat The Rebel Flagship with the Mantis Cruiser.
shipBlueprint.desc: Designed for use inside nebula, this cruiser lacks sensors and relies instead on the guile and cunning of the Slugs.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_JELLY_2
The Stormwalker
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earning two of the three Slug Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
shipBlueprint.desc: This boarding ship has no medical facilities and must manage its explosives carefully to keep the crew alive.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_JELLY_3
Ariolimax
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reaching sector 8 with the Slug Cruiser B on any difficulty with Advanced Edition Content enabled will unlock layout C.
shipBlueprint.desc: Slugs are often skilled in the arts of misdirection and manipulation. With Hacking and Mind Control systems, this ship capitalizes on that fact.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_ROCK
Bulwark
shipBlueprint.unlock: See the Rock war vessel encounter. Alternatively, defeat The Rebel Flagship with the Slug cruiser.
shipBlueprint.desc: Similar to its designers, this super dense behemoth uses brute force to overwhelm its foes.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_ROCK_2
Shivan
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earning two of the three Rock Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
shipBlueprint.desc: With no airlocks, this ship must rely entirely on its rock crew to put out fires.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_ROCK_3
Tektite
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reaching sector 8 with the Rock Cruiser B with Advanced Mode enabled will unlock layout C.
shipBlueprint.desc: Contact has been made with the Crystalline race and this cruiser was offered to the Federation as part of diplomatic discussions between the sister species.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_STEALTH
The Nesasio
shipBlueprint.unlock: See the Engi fleet discussion event. Alternatively, defeat the Rebel Flagship with the Rock Cruiser.
shipBlueprint.desc: Constructed for the Federation by the Engi, this ship is designed to use cloaking technology and speed to get behind enemy lines.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_STEALTH_2
DA-SR 12
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earning two of the three Stealth Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
shipBlueprint.desc: Built like a glass cannon, this ship is hard to handle. If its cloaking can keep it safe long enough to charge its weapon, few cruisers can withstand its might.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_STEALTH_3
Simo-H
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reaching sector 8 with the Stealth Cruiser B and Advanced Mode enabled will unlock layout C.
shipBlueprint.desc: This ship was part of an Engi experiment to make a power efficient version of the Zoltan shield. Unfortunately this required the removal of the Cloaking system.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_ANAEROBIC
Kruos
shipBlueprint.unlock: Unlock 4 ships (Excluding The Kestrel) to unlock this ship.
shipBlueprint.desc: The sharp knife-like structures make Lanius ships a sight to behold. This cruiser was adapted to support the other races of the Federation.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_ANAEROBIC_2
The Shrike
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earning two of the three Lanius Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
shipBlueprint.desc: The racial ability of the Lanius make them fearsome combatants in small quarters. Combine that with a Mind Control system and this ship is a force to be reckoned with.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_MANTIS
The Gila Monster
shipBlueprint.unlock: See Legendary Thief KazaaakplethKilik random event. Alternatively, defeat The Rebel Flagship with the Zoltan Cruiser.
shipBlueprint.desc: This warship is designed to enhance its crew for close combat missions.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_MANTIS_2
The Basilisk
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earning two of the three Mantis Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.
shipBlueprint.desc: This warship encourages sending massive boarding parties and keeping strong defense.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_MANTIS_3
The Theseus
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reaching Sector 8 with the Mantis Cruiser B and Advanced Edition Content enabled will unlock layout C.
shipBlueprint.desc: With a large teleporter and weapons designed to impede enemy crew, this ship is deadly in the hands of a capable boarding party.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_CRYSTAL
Bravais
shipBlueprint.unlock: See Ancestry (ship achievement) and its linked pages for directions on unlocking the Crystal Cruiser Alternatively, beat the Flagship with layout A and B of every ship (excluding The Lanius Cruiser)
shipBlueprint.desc: This powerful vessel is powered by the secret technologies of the lost Crystalline Beings.

shipBlueprint.name: PLAYER_SHIP_CRYSTAL_2
Carnelian
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn at least two out of three achievements for the Crystal Cruiser
shipBlueprint.desc: Their unique racial ability makes the Crystal beings very adept at ship boarding. This ship was designed for such raiding parties.

augBlueprint.title: Defense Scrambler
augBlueprint.desc: Enemy Defense Drone I, Defense Drone II, and Anti-Combat drones cannot acquire or shoot down targets. Your own defense drones still fire.

augBlueprint.name: ZOLTAN_BYPASS
augBlueprint.title: Zoltan Shield Bypass
augBlueprint.desc: Crew teleportation, bomb teleportation, and mind control work through Zoltan Shields.

augBlueprint.name: CRYSTAL_SHARDS
augBlueprint.title: Crystal Vengeance
augBlueprint.desc: Each time the ship takes damage there is a 10 percent chance to fire a crystal shot that does 1 damage, has a 10 percent chance to breach, has a 20 percent chance to stun for 3 seconds, ignores shields, is affected by evasion, and can be shot down by defense drones.

augBlueprint.name: STASIS_POD
augBlueprint.title: Damaged Stasis Pod
augBlueprint.desc: More than one can be held at a time with each copy in an augmentation slot, each can be acquired only from the Dense asteroid field distress call, and each Zoltan research facility opens a single pod to yield a Crystal crewmember.

augBlueprint.name: DRONE_SPEED
augBlueprint.title: Drone Reactor Booster
augBlueprint.desc: Crew drone movement speed is increased by 25 percent, from 50 percent of regular crew speed to 62.5 percent.

augBlueprint.name: NANO_MEDBAY
augBlueprint.title: Engi Med-bot Dispersal
augBlueprint.desc: It heals 1.6 health points per second when the medbay is powered, medbay upgrades do not affect it, it does not heal crew on another ship, and it does nothing with a clone bay.

augBlueprint.name: CREW_STIMS
augBlueprint.title: Mantis Pheromones
augBlueprint.desc: Crew movement speed increases by 25 percent on your ship and while boarding an enemy.

augBlueprint.name: SLUG_GEL
augBlueprint.title: Slug Repair Gel
augBlueprint.desc: It fixes all breaches simultaneously at 75 percent of regular crew speed and stacks with crew repairs.

augBlueprint.name: ENERGY_SHIELD
augBlueprint.title: Zoltan Shield
augBlueprint.desc: It has 5 points of energy shielding that are completely recharged on an FTL jump, enemy shields are replenished on revisiting the beacon, only the initial boarding party of a boarding event passes through it, and Zoltan Shield Bypass lets crew teleportation, bomb teleportation, and mind control pass through it.

droneBlueprint.name: COMBAT_1
droneBlueprint.title: Combat Drone Mark I
droneBlueprint.desc: Circles the enemy ship and keeps firing at random rooms. Needs 2 power bars.

droneBlueprint.name: COMBAT_2
droneBlueprint.title: Combat Drone Mark II
droneBlueprint.desc: Circles the enemy ship and keeps firing at random rooms. Needs 4 power bars.

droneBlueprint.name: COMBAT_BEAM
droneBlueprint.title: Anti-Ship Beam Drone I
droneBlueprint.desc: Circles the enemy ship and keeps firing at random rooms. Needs 2 power bars.

droneBlueprint.name: COMBAT_BEAM_2
droneBlueprint.title: Anti-Ship Beam Drone II
droneBlueprint.desc: Circles the enemy ship and keeps firing at random rooms. Needs 3 power bars.

droneBlueprint.name: DEFENSE_1
droneBlueprint.title: Defense Drone Mark I
droneBlueprint.desc: Holds station beside your hull and shoots down what comes in. Needs 2 power bars.

droneBlueprint.name: DEFENSE_2
droneBlueprint.title: Defense Drone Mark II
droneBlueprint.desc: Holds station beside your hull and shoots down what comes in. Needs 3 power bars.

droneBlueprint.name: ANTI_DRONE
droneBlueprint.title: Anti-Combat Drone
droneBlueprint.desc: Holds station beside your hull and shoots down what comes in. Needs 1 power bar.

droneBlueprint.name: DRONE_SHIELD
droneBlueprint.title: Shield Overcharger
droneBlueprint.desc: Adds a temporary shield layer while it is powered. Needs 3 power bars.

droneBlueprint.name: BATTLE
droneBlueprint.title: Anti-Personnel Drone
droneBlueprint.desc: Walks your ship and fights intruders. Needs 2 power bars.

droneBlueprint.name: REPAIR
droneBlueprint.title: System Repair Drone
droneBlueprint.desc: Walks your ship and fixes damaged systems. Needs 1 power bar.

droneBlueprint.name: SHIP_REPAIR
droneBlueprint.title: Hull Repair Drone
droneBlueprint.desc: Leaves the hull to patch outer plating. Needs 2 power bars.

droneBlueprint.name: BOARDER
droneBlueprint.title: Boarding Drone
droneBlueprint.desc: Rams the enemy hull and fights its way through the rooms. Needs 3 power bars.

droneBlueprint.name: BOARDER_ION
droneBlueprint.title: Ion Intruder Drone
droneBlueprint.desc: Rams the enemy hull and fights its way through the rooms. Needs 3 power bars.

droneBlueprint.name: BOARDER_BOSS
droneBlueprint.title: Boarding Drone (Boss)
droneBlueprint.desc: Rams the enemy hull and fights its way through the rooms. Needs 2 power bars.

powerList.power: Adds 1 power bar to its room
Drains the air in its room
Can seal the room it stands in
